name: Question 2
problem:
The matrix $A$ and vectors ${b}_{1}$, ${b}_{2}$, ${b}_{3}$ are given below. Which of the vectors lie in $\text{Null}(A)?$

$$
A=[\begin{aligned}2 & -1 \\ -4 & 2 \\ 6 & -3\end{aligned}],\,{b}_{1}=[\begin{aligned}3 \\ 6\end{aligned}],\,{b}_{2}=[\begin{aligned}-1 \\ 3\end{aligned}],\,{b}_{3}=[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 4\end{aligned}]
$$
worked_solution:
A vector $b$ lies in $\text{Null}(A)$ if $Ab=0.$ So, we need to compute the product of $A$ and each of the given vectors and check whether it is equal to $0:$

$$
\begin{aligned}A{b}_{1} & =[\begin{aligned}2 & -1 \\ -4 & 2 \\ 6 & -3\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}3 \\ 6\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 0 \\ 0\end{aligned}]=0\,✓ \\ A{b}_{2} & =[\begin{aligned}2 & -1 \\ -4 & 2 \\ 6 & -3\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}-1 \\ 3\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}-5 \\ 10 \\ -15\end{aligned}]\ne 0\,\times  \\ A{b}_{3} & =[\begin{aligned}2 & -1 \\ -4 & 2 \\ 6 & -3\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}2 \\ 4\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 0 \\ 0\end{aligned}]=0\,✓\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, only ${b}_{1}$ and ${b}_{3}$ lie in $\text{Null}(A).$

Question 2
?

The matrix A and vectors b1, b2, b3 are given below. Which of the vectors lie in Null(A)?

A=[2−1−426−3],b1=[36],b2=[−13],b3=[24]

a
b1 and b2 only
b
 b2 only
c
b1 and b3 only
d
b2 and b3 only
e
 b1 only
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

A vector b lies in Null(A) if Ab=0. So, we need to compute the product of A and each of the given vectors and check whether it is equal to 0:

Ab1=[2−1−426−3][36]=[000]=0✓Ab2=[2−1−426−3][−13]=[−510−15]≠0×Ab3=[2−1−426−3][24]=[000]=0✓

Therefore, only b1 and b3 lie in Null(A).
